column1: # Authored from the 2024 PHB SRD (CC-BY 4.0). Spot-check against the printed PHB — wording may have been adjusted in errata.

column2: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can also deal 1d6 Cold damage to that target. In addition, the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
